-- Enhanced Session Logs Insert Query with Routing
-- This SQL goes in your "Store Session Data" PostgreSQL node
-- After successful insert, the complete data flows to multiple downstream nodes

INSERT INTO rag_analytics.session_logs (
  session_id, timestamp, execution_time, success_rate, overall_confidence,
  confidence_health_score, feedback_requests, modification_rate, user_satisfaction,
  alert_severity, health_score, llm_model, embedding_model,
  chunk_size, chunk_overlap, similarity_top_k, resume_file, application_form,
  average_step_time, bottleneck_step, bottleneck_time, performance_variance,
  total_fields_processed, total_fields_modified, feedback_efficiency, 
  critical_issues_count, warnings_count, step_times_json, raw_data_json, created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.session_id }}',
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
  {{ $json.execution_time || 0 }},
  {{ $json.success_rate || 1 }},
  {{ $json.overall_confidence || 0 }},
  {{ $json.confidence_health_score || 0 }},
  {{ $json.feedback_requests || 0 }},
  {{ $json.modification_rate || 0 }},
  {{ $json.user_satisfaction || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.alert_severity || "INFO" }}',
  {{ $json.health_score || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.llm_model || "unknown" }}',
  '{{ $json.embedding_model || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.chunk_size || 0 }},
  {{ $json.chunk_overlap || 0 }},
  {{ $json.similarity_top_k || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.resume_file || "unknown" }}',
  '{{ $json.application_form || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.average_step_time || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.bottleneck_step || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.bottleneck_time || 0 }},
  {{ $json.performance_variance || 0 }},
  {{ $json.total_fields_processed || 0 }},
  {{ $json.total_fields_modified || 0 }},
  {{ $json.feedback_efficiency || 1 }},
  {{ $json.critical_issues_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.warnings_count || 0 }},
  $${{ $json.step_times_json || "{}" }}$$::jsonb,
  $${{ $json.raw_data_json || "{}" }}$$::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING session_id, created_at;

INSERT INTO rag_analytics.field_analytics (
  session_id, timestamp, field_name, original_field_name,
  avg_confidence, min_confidence, max_confidence,
  confidence_variance, stability_score, health_status,
  needs_optimization, sample_count,
  llm_model, embedding_model, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, 
  similarity_top_k, resume_file, confidence_scores_json,
  processing_timestamp, field_error, created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.session_id }}',
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
  '{{ $json.field_name }}',
  '{{ $json.original_field_name || $json.field_name }}',
  {{ $json.avg_confidence || 0 }},
  {{ $json.min_confidence || 0 }},
  {{ $json.max_confidence || 0 }},
  {{ $json.confidence_variance || 0 }},
  {{ $json.stability_score || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.health_status || "UNKNOWN" }}',
  {{ $json.needs_optimization || false }},
  {{ $json.sample_count || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.llm_model || "unknown" }}',
  '{{ $json.embedding_model || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.chunk_size || 0 }},
  {{ $json.chunk_overlap || 0 }},
  {{ $json.similarity_top_k || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.resume_file || "unknown" }}',
  $${{ $json.confidence_scores_json || "[]" }}$$::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.processing_timestamp }}',
  NULLIF(NULLIF('{{ $json.field_error }}', 'null'), ''),
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

-- Fixed SQL Query for Store Feedback Analytics Node
-- Simplified version that works with n8n templates
INSERT INTO rag_analytics.feedback_analytics (
  session_id, "timestamp", iteration_number, fields_modified_count,
  fields_modified_list, feedback_details, modification_rate,
  llm_model, embedding_model, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2::timestamptz, $3, $4,
  ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($5::jsonb)),
  $6::jsonb, $7, $8, $9, NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

-- SQL Query for Store Confidence Scores Node
INSERT INTO rag_analytics.confidence_scores (
  session_id, timestamp, field_name, confidence_score, score_sequence,
  llm_model, embedding_model, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, similarity_top_k, created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.session_id }}',
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}', 
  '{{ $json.field_name }}',
  {{ $json.confidence_score || 0 }},
  {{ $json.score_sequence || 1 }},
  '{{ $json.llm_model || "unknown" }}',
  '{{ $json.embedding_model || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.chunk_size || 0 }},
  {{ $json.chunk_overlap || 0 }},
  {{ $json.similarity_top_k || 0 }},
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;
